title: Recording: (It’s All Down To) Goodnight Vienna, Goodnight Vienna (Reprise), Only You by Ringo Starr | 1974
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr recorded three songs for his fourth studio album, Goodnight Vienna, on 6 August 1974.

Joining him in the studio on this day was John Lennon. They worked on three songs: the Lennon-penned ‘(It’s All Down To) Goodnight Vienna’, its reprise, and ‘Only You’.

This was just something John had written and presented because he thought it would be good for me. We had such fun with it we decided to title the album Goodnight Vienna because it made no sense. We had a lot of fun together. And in all honesty, in the earlier and middle seventies, it was good to have another Beatle in the room because it took the pressure off. People were looking like, ‘There’s a Beatle!’ It was like you weren’t human. At least if you could hang out with each other, it wasn’t like, ‘Look – there’s one of them!’ In any case, it was always my pleasure to hang out with John.
Ringo Starr
Photograph – The Very Best Of Ringo Starr

Lennon and May Pang were staying at the Beverly Wilshire hotel in Los Angeles. They were driven to Sunset Sound Recorders to begin work at the session, which lasted from 7pm until 1.30 the following morning.

Starr covered ‘Only You’ at Lennon’s suggestion. The recording features Starr’s vocals and other instrumentation over Lennon’s studio demo.

Ringo was short one song, and John says, ‘Well, I’ve been saving this one for myself, but I think you, you could do this one. It’d be a good song for you to do.’ And it was great watching it ’cause there’s Ringo and Jim Keltner playing drums, and John did the lead vocal, which Ringo later overdubbed.
May Pang
The Lost Lennon Tapes

After the session, Starr, Lennon, Pang, and Starr’s partner Nancy Lee Andrews drank at The Fiddler on LA’s Sunset and LaBrea.

‘Goodnight Vienna’ was completed without Lennon on 18 September, and ‘Only You’ had more overdubs at an unknown date, again in September.
